build.comparisonSource: shared frozen checkout based on a85d3a61 with terminal bridge changes

workloads.suite: 600 x 32-byte writes / 16 ms; 600 x 64-KiB writes / 16 ms; chunked PNG Kitty fixture, Unicode and BEL; stdout backpressure honored
workloads.cpu: 25-second capture, continuous workload started after 2 seconds; same pane, foreground geometry and device; app phase tracing disabled
workloads.note: Herdr coalesces/redraws output: producer throughput is not transport throughput. Captures are single runs, not replicated statistical trials. Native app had longer process lifetime than control.

latencyMs.boundary: React Native JS frame receipt to two-rAF acknowledgement received by React Native
Android native callback entry to native two-rAF acknowledgement

lifecycle.scenario: small frequent frames; Home for one second; foreground app; output finishes without a crash or renderer stall
lifecycle.note: Bridge attach time is not reconnect-to-visible or tab-switch latency.

limitations.trueSocketInboundToVisible: Not measured with a common correlated boundary; do not calculate a speedup ratio from the two latency rows.
limitations.presentation: Two requestAnimationFrame callbacks are a proxy, not compositor-confirmed presentation.
limitations.cpuAndMemory: Observed CPU and app RSS are higher in the native capture. Process age, retained renderers and other application work were not held constant. No CPU, allocation-rate or sustained whole-app memory improvement is established.
limitations.throughput: Observed payload rates are coalesced Herdr workload rates, not maximum bridge capacity.
limitations.longDurationMemorySoak: Not completed; bounded transport and ownership checks do not prove stable application RSS.
limitations.graphics: PNG absent in both legacy and native physical Herdr fixture; byte ordering tests pass. Existing server attachment limitation documented in docs/terminal-images.md. Physical image rendering is not verified.
limitations.iosPerformance: Skipped at user request; thin arm64 Rust and both native targets compile; generated callback ownership probe passes on mini.

validation.dependencyPatch: Actual patch-package clean application, all four dependency files byte-for-byte comparison
validation.nativeCallbackOwnership: Four actual generated C++ callbacks, 1000 cleared-runtime calls each, live calls and teardown; zero outstanding or double-freed buffers
validation.iosArm64: Rust, WhipSsh target and react-native-webview target pass on mini
validation.androidArm64: Upload-signed release build and in-place install pass

isolatedTerminalOnlyCommit.generatedBindings: Regenerated from isolated terminal-only arm64 Android Rust source; concurrent chat/title APIs excluded
